extName.message: Chat on Second Screen for Twitch

extDescription.message: Watch Twitch streams in fullscreen on one monitor while the live chat opens automatically on your second screen.

actionTitle.message: Open chat on the other screen

pageButtonTitle.message: Open the chat on your other screen and put the stream in fullscreen ($1)

toastWrongPage.message: Open a Twitch channel page (twitch.tv/channel-name) to use this feature.

toastReload.message: The extension was updated: reload the page (F5) and try again.

toastSingleScreen.message: Only one screen detected: the chat opened in a separate window, but fullscreen will hide it. Use Alt+Tab to switch.

toastSameScreen.message: The chat opened on the same screen as the stream (saved screen). Change it in the extension menu.

promptChatOpened.message: The chat is open on $1. Click to watch the stream in fullscreen.

promptDefault.message: The chat is open. Click to watch the stream in fullscreen.

promptSingleScreen.message: Only one screen detected: the chat is in a separate window (Alt+Tab to reach it). Click to watch the stream in fullscreen.

toastFullscreenRefused.message: The browser refused fullscreen. Use the player's fullscreen button.

errNoDisplays.message: Unable to read the list of screens.

popupOpenButton.message: Open chat on the other screen

popupFullscreenNote.message: From this menu, the browser doesn't allow direct fullscreen: a “Go fullscreen” button will appear on the Twitch page.

popupNotChannel.message: Open a Twitch channel page (twitch.tv/channel-name), then click the extension again.

popupSavedUnplugged.message: — the saved screen is no longer connected

popupSingleScreen.message: Only one screen detected: the chat will open on the same screen.

popupAutoHint.message: The chat will go to a different screen than the stream.
